description: The Japay-Py march began on 17 Nov, reached Asunción on 20 Nov and, per a Nov 22 follow-up, concluded on 21 Nov after 65 km and proclamation delivery. ABC Color and organizer-derived sources may share underlying information; 138 is an attributed count and policy response remains unknown.
required_followup: If available, seek evidence of any state response to delivered proclamations and clarify how organizer count distinguishes marchers from the larger destination crowd.

description: Coverage remains non-exhaustive despite additional Spanish sector/regional searches. Reports document distinct FNC actions at MAG (4 Nov), intermittent PY02 blockades in Caaguazú (6 Nov), and below-threshold CDE customs gathering (9 Nov). Organizer/continuity relationships and adjacent-month links are unresolved.
required_followup: Continue regional/sector and adjacent-month discovery; determine episode links without merging by date/sector alone.

description: A separate Diario HOY article reports a CDE Libre manifestation at the Palace of Justice on 20 Nov demanding celerity in a criminal case involving a mayor, but reports no attendance. Its relationship to party advocacy and the 50-person threshold remain unresolved.
required_followup: Seek event-day images/video with usable crowd context, organizer count and independent reporting; resolve motive and any state response.

description: 4 Nov FNC protest confirmed by two publishers, no count; 6 Nov multi-site PY02 blockades no protester total, and ABC’s 100 is police not crowd size. DNIT response is broad, not event-specific accommodation. 9 Nov crowd estimates 30/40 below threshold.
required_followup: Seek simultaneous counts, meeting outcomes, event-specific state response and explicit relationships among action dates.
